preconditions.description: The number of factories N must be between 1 and 500,000.
The number of businessmen M must be between 1 and 500,000.
The number of years Q must be between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= parent[i] <= i for i in range(N - 1))
preconditions.description: Each factory's parent must be a valid index less than or equal to its own index.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= B[i] <= M for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each factory must be owned by a valid businessman index.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= threshold[i] <= 10**18 for i in range(M))
preconditions.description: Each businessman's threshold must be between 1 and 10^18.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= F <= N and 1 <= X <= 10**6 and 0 <= D <= 10**6 for _ in range(Q))
preconditions.description: Each donation report must have valid factory index, donation amount, and distribution increment.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == 'rekt' or int(stdout[i]) >= 1 for i in range(M))
postconditions.description: Each businessman's output must either be 'rekt' or a valid year number greater than or equal to 1.
At least one businessman must have earned their desired amount within the given years.
